custom_dimensions.rationale: Locates where buyers stop in the four-step checkout, as a bounded step id.
Names the validation rule that stopped a buyer as a bounded code, never the UI copy or a field value.
Separates funnel behavior by the book format in progress (digital, classic, premium).

key_events.rationale: Only the signed Stripe webhook's settled winner writes a purchase, once per paid Checkout Session; GA4 stays behavioral evidence, never payment authority.

not_key_events.rationale: Traffic context; sessions are the denominator, so marking page views would count browsing as conversion.
A behavioral step read as an event count for checkout start rate; only a settled payment is a conversion.
Funnel diagnostics counted per step; a step view is not an outcome.
Funnel diagnostics counted per step; completing a step is not an outcome.
Friction diagnostics; a blocked step is not an outcome.
Funnel context counted as users who tried the name preview; engagement is not an outcome.
Funnel stage counted as users who submitted a validated order; only a settled payment is a conversion.
